title: Method and apparatus for augmenting knowledge using information of federated learning

pse.problem: The existing federated learning methods have limitations in generating a model optimized for the data distributions of each individual device, particularly when dealing with low-end IoT devices.
pse.solution_function: The system collects local information from multiple devices (including low-end devices), generates a federated global parameter for a global model using the collected parameters of local models, and uses this parameter to learn a large model. The learned large model approximates true labels for further learning.
pse.solution_structure: The system comprises a transceiver unit, a data storage unit, a federated learning execution unit, and a large model learning unit.
pse.solution_implementation: Local devices transmit their global parameter, local latent vector, and local loss value to the system. The federated learning execution unit collects these parameters, generates a federated global parameter, and sends it back to the devices. The large model learning unit uses both the local information and the federated global parameter to learn and approximate true labels for the large model.
pse.effect: The proposed method allows low-end IoT devices to participate in federated learning, enabling the creation of a global model optimized for various data distributions without exposing private data. The use of a large model further improves the accuracy of label approximations.
